samir: Quick priming note — I'm oncall 10:00–14:00 PT today. Before I take the handoff can folks confirm the pre-oncall checklist? runbook link: https://redwood.infr/runbooks/oncall-prep :eyes:
elaine: copying checklist from runbook now. I'll verify VPN + pager. ping me if anything nonstandard.
maria: FYI I pushed a tiny rollback-safe change to the routing config this morning (PR #4527). No traffic impact expected but worth flagging in case of alerts.
samir: thanks @maria — noted. @elaine can you confirm pager groups and that the dev corp creds are in the vault?
elaine: Pager test: sending test to #pager-group so you get it. Also verified dev-corp read access in Vault: 2 keys present (last rotated 2025-11-02).
sre-bot: automated check: VPN endpoints reachable: vpn-us1 OK, vpn-eu1 OK. Pager integrations: OK. Token expiration: 1 service token (svc-deploy) expires in 9 days — consider rotation.
devon: quick heads-up — remote build runner in eu-west had transient failures earlier. I restarted the runner and it's healthy now. I left a short runbook note: /confluence/runbooks/build-runner-restart. No oncall action expected but flagging as risk.
oncall-ops-bot: handoff checklist status: VPN ✅, Pager ✅, Vault creds ✅, Runbook latest commit 167a4c (2026-02-10). If you need escalation path: @oncall-sre, @platform-lead.
samir: all set on my end. I'll be available on slack and pager. If anyone sees anything unusual during the 10–14 slot please mention me directly or use the pager. :thumbsup:
